Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

Every data center Hut 8 builds depends on a particular list of materials that are expensive, commodity driven, and critical to get on time. This Sourcing Manager owns those categories.  

The Sourcing Manager works cross-functionally with Engineering, Construction, Finance/AP, Legal, and Operations to protect project schedules and minimize material supply risk across capital projects. 

Some of the responsibilities you can expect include the following: 

  • Own sourcing strategies for specialty construction materials including MV and LV cables, conduit,  grounding systems, fiber, , and electrical distribution equipment across the full site supply chain.  
  • Lead RFQs and technical and commercial bid evaluations with Engineering, including approved manufacturers and approved equals 
  • Negotiate supply and frame agreements, including copper and aluminum price adjusters, tariff fluctuation strategies lead time commitments, and warranty terms 
  • Secure manufacturing slots for long lead equipment and track production against project schedules, identifying early risk indicators such as capacity constraints or sub-supplier delays 
  • Qualify and dual source critical suppliers so no single manufacturer can stop a project 
  • Partner with the procure-to-pay team so awarded agreements translate into accurate purchase orders, on time delivery, and payments aligned with contractual milestones 
  • Report category spend, savings, and supply risk, and recommend improvements that reduce risk and improve cash flow timing 

ABOUT YOU 

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Business, Engineering, or related field preferred (equivalent experience considered) 
  • 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing or procurement of electrical materials and equipment for capital projects 
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating supply agreements with manufacturers and distributors, including metal price adjustment terms 
  • Comfortable reading single line diagrams, cable schedules, and equipment specifications at a commercial level 
  • Track record of managing long-leaded equipment and supplier capacity constraints 
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving infrastructure or industrial environment 
  • Preferred: Data center, utility, or mission critical project experience; experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Odoo) 

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
descriptions.job-0s97cb2:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

Kalshi Prime is one of the fastest-growing parts of Kalshi. As an FCM, Prime operates under CFTC and NFA rules. That means its support work has real obligations: complaints have to be acknowledged, logged, escalated and closed on set timelines, and every interaction has to be documented well enough to hold up to regulatory review.

You'll be the first point of contact for Prime customers, both individual traders and institutional clients. You'll also help build how Prime support runs: queues, macros, help center content, escalation paths and reporting. You'll work closely with Compliance, Surveillance, Risk, Product and Engineering.

Because we're a small team, this is also a generalist Operations role. When Prime is quiet, or another queue needs help, you'll work wherever it matters most that week: account security, identity verification, fraud review, market questions or a new launch. This is a high-impact role that can be remote (US) or based in our NYC office.

What You'll Do

Kalshi Prime Support

  • Answer Prime account holders across email, chat and in-app support about margin, funding and withdrawals, positions, liquidations and account status

  • Guide institutional clients through onboarding: request and review entity documents (formation, ownership and control, tax forms), follow up on gaps, and send complete files to Compliance for approval

  • Own first-level complaint handling: acknowledge complaints quickly, log each one in full detail, escalate to Compliance, and track it until it's resolved within required timelines

  • Coordinate with Compliance, Surveillance, Risk and Engineering on account holds, restrictions and escalations, and explain outcomes to customers clearly and accurately

  • Keep complete, accurate records of customer interactions to meet regulatory recordkeeping requirements

Kalshi Operations Generalist

  • Cover other Kalshi Operations queues as needed: exchange account questions, identity verification, account security and lockouts, and risk and fraud reviews

  • Help during launches, incidents and volume spikes, wherever the backlog is

  • Spot patterns across queues and bring them to Product, Engineering and Risk with examples and volumes

Process, Tooling & Documentation

  • Build and maintain Prime macros, help center articles, SOPs and escalation playbooks

  • Track and report on support metrics such as first response time, resolution time, complaint aging and CSAT

  • Improve workflows and automation, including AI-assisted support tools, so the team can scale without losing quality

Market & Product Expertise

  • Learn how futures, margin and event contracts work at Kalshi well enough to explain them simply

  • Keep up with new Prime products and platform changes, and update documentation before customers start asking

What You Bring

  • 2+ years in customer support, operations, client onboarding, compliance operations or a related role

  • Excellent written communication: you can explain margin, an account hold or a document request clearly to a retail trader and to an institutional client

  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of documenting your work. In a regulated business, the record is part of the job

  • Good judgment about when to resolve an issue yourself and when to escalate it

  • Comfort learning new tools quickly and juggling several queues and priorities at once

  • Coachable and eager to take on more over time; you enjoy the pace and ambiguity of a startup

Nice to have

  • Experience at an FCM, broker-dealer, futures or crypto exchange, or another CFTC-, SEC- or NFA-regulated firm

  • Familiarity with futures, perpetuals, margin or derivatives trading

  • Experience with institutional or entity onboarding, KYB/KYC, or AML review

  • Experience handling formal customer complaints or working closely with a compliance team

  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools, or building AI-assisted support workflows

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $100,000–$115,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

About Chainlink Labs

Chainlink Labs is one of the primary contributing developers of Chainlink, the standard for onchain finance enabling high-quality data, secure cross-chain interoperability, and compliant connectivity across global markets. Chainlink powers leading tokenized assets, financial institutions, market infrastructures, and decentralized applications by providing secure access to real-world data, cross-chain messaging, and blockchain connectivity across any network. The Chainlink standard has enabled tens of trillions of dollars in transaction value and is helping unify global markets onchain. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, Aave, Polymarket, Lido, and many others.

Chainlink Labs is a world-class team of developers, researchers, and capital markets experts, and has ranked among Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology, Fortune's Best Medium Workplace, and the Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces. Learn more at chain.link or chainlinklabs.com.

About Chainlink

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About the Role

This role exists to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and observability of Chainlink’s data systems as the network scales across assets and use cases. It focuses on building robust data pipelines and models that power benchmarking, monitoring, and downstream data access. The role enables faster product development and unlocks quant and data science workflows through high-quality, accessible data.

Your Impact

  • Deliver data pipelines that achieve 99.99% ingestion uptime across critical datasets

  • Improve benchmark accuracy by building resilient, scalable data modeling and processing systems

  • Establish end-to-end observability, ensuring data freshness, completeness, and accuracy are continuously validated

  • Route actionable alerts to the appropriate owners, reducing noise and accelerating issue resolution

  • Enable rapid delivery of new data methodologies to support emerging products and asset coverage

  • Provide clean, well-structured datasets that accelerate modeling, analytics, and decision-making across teams

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience building scalable data models and pipelines for analytics using SQL and Python

  • Experience working with blockchain or traditional financial market data, with a clear understanding of one domain

  • Proven ability to define and implement metrics for evaluating complex systems, including data quality and system performance

  • Built and maintained data pipelines handling large-scale, time-series or asynchronous datasets

  • Strong understanding of data modeling, partitioning, and performance optimization in analytical systems

  • Experience designing and implementing data quality checks covering freshness, completeness, and accuracy

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience working with real-time or streaming data systems such as Flink, Beam, or similar frameworks

  • Familiarity with order books, trade data, and aggregation methodologies in financial systems

  • Understanding of decentralized exchanges and approaches to sourcing and structuring onchain data

  • Background in quantitative statistics or applied statistical analysis

  • Experience working in investment, trading, or market data environments

  • Demonstrated ability to work with noisy, multi-source datasets and derive reliable analytical outputs
